title: Hitam Dalam Asap
genre: Malay mak yong court ensemble song (Kelantan rebab, serunai and gong)
subject: A young Labu Sayong potter in Kuala Kangsar stays up all night feeding rice husk to the smoke-firing pit that turns the pots black, and hides a note in the base of the smallest pot for the city girl who bought it.
caption: Malay mak yong court ensemble song, Kelantan classical folk style, slow processional pulse. Rebab bowing long sustained phrases, serunai playing ornamented reed melody, gendang pair keeping a steady low beat, tetawak gong marking each phrase end, canang tapping a light pattern. Dry intimate room recording with warm wooden resonance. Female vocal, mid register, ornamented but clearly sung. 78 BPM, D minor. Tender, patient, quietly in love. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. No pop drums, no synth, no autotune, no electric guitar, no rap, no EDM.
lyrics:
[Intro - rebab and serunai, slow gong]

[Verse 1]
Sekam padi membara semalaman
Aku jaga api di tepi lubang
Labu Sayong perlahan jadi hitam
Mata tak lelap, tangan pun penat

[Pre-Chorus]
Di dasar yang paling kecil
Kuselit sehelai nota

[Chorus]
Hitam, hitam dalam asap
Namamu kutulis di perut labu
Bila kau tuang air sejuk
Bacalah aku sedikit-sedikit

[Verse 2]
Semalam datang gadis dari bandar
Dia pilih labu yang paling kecil
Dia tanya kenapa dasarnya berat
Aku senyum, tak berani jawab

[Pre-Chorus]
Subuh pun tiba, api reda
Aku masih menunggu balasan

[Chorus]
Hitam, hitam dalam asap
Seminggu kemudian dia datang semula
Katanya air labu itu manis
Dan ada tulisan di dalamnya

[Outro - rebab alone, gong fades]
Hitam, hitam dalam asap
Labu kecil, jawablah dia
